## Root cause — a bound-but-DENIED credential, not a code regression and not the placeholder

The whole chain, all read-only evidence:

1. **The owed H7 seeding act happened.** `rhema-prod-anthropic-admin-key` now has **four**
   versions (was one at the D-ECON.1-1 read): v1 2026-09-17T05:49Z (the recorded
   self-marked `placeholder` seed), v2 2026-10-29T17:19Z, v3 2026-10-30T04:03Z, v4
   **2026-10-30T04:30Z** — the operator seeded a real credential 10-29→10-30 (three
   versions in ~11 h). `versions/latest` = v4 since 10-30T04:30Z.
2. **The worker binds `versions/latest` at each instance boot.** Every deployed revision
   (verified 00083/00084/00085/00088) carries
   `ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY_SECRET=projects/rhema-507501/secrets/rhema-prod-anthropic-admin-key/versions/latest`
   (a NAME, never a value). The boot-time placeholder guard (`main.ts`,
   `/placeholder/i.test(value)` → no reportSource) is intact — the only code change since
   PRB.17 was R7COPY.0's whitespace reformat (`abc91dba`, verified diff).
3. **A non-placeholder value has been bound since 10-30T05:13Z.** Cloud Logging: the last
   `[worker] ANTHROPIC admin key is a placeholder` line is 10-28T03:56Z; instance boots
   10-30T05:13Z (rev 00084), 10-30T19:29Z, 10-31T16:33Z, 11-05T02:04Z (rev 00085), 11-05T21:06Z,
   11-06T20:28Z and since log it **never** → `reportSource` was constructed on v4 every boot
   since 10-30T05:13Z.
4. **The last completed reconcile ran 10-30T03:15Z** (`report=skipped, window=skipped,
   balances 6 divergences` — the six seeded showcase accounts, the recorded R6FOR.1 datum).
   **No completion log line exists for 10-31→11-04**; no `usage.reconcile` job rows exist for
   those days either.
5. **`pgboss.job` (read 2026-11-11T23:42Z): exactly 7 failed rows**, created
   11-05T03:15:19Z → 11-11T03:15:12Z daily, `retry_count=2`, output
   `provider report fetch failed: 403` — thrown on **both** endpoint calls (`cost_report` =
   `Promise.all` index 0; `usage_report` = index 1 on the 11-07 row). Failed rows persist
   until `keep_until` = created+14 d BUT terminal jobs are swept at `completed_on +
   deletion_seconds (7 d)` — so failures on 10-31→11-04 would have been culled 11-07→11-11 and
   are invisible now. They are NOT absent because the job didn't run: created-but-unworked
   jobs persist 14 d (none exist), the cron slot demonstrably fired those days
   (`billing.auto-reload` logged 03:20Z on 10-31 AND 11-04; the schedule row has existed
   continuously since 09-17, `created_on` never re-seeded), and the running instance had a
   non-placeholder key bound. **Conclusion: the job ran and failed 403 nightly since
   2026-10-31T03:15Z — 12 consecutive failures; the last 7 (11-05→11-11) are the retained
   tail the R6WATCH.1 datum named.**
6. **The 403 is a permission-class denial, not an unrecognized key.** Anthropic's Admin API
   (`/v1/organizations/cost_report`, `/v1/organizations/usage_report/messages`) authenticates
   `x-api-key`; a workspace-scoped `sk-ant-api…` key is refused **401** (verified live, STB.4;
   `provider-report.ts` header comment). A **403** is authenticated-but-forbidden — the bound
   credential IS recognized but is not a usable Admin-API credential for this org's reports:
   an admin key minted in a DIFFERENT org (keys are org-bound), a wrong-surface key (claude.ai
   Enterprise `sk-ant-api01-…` keys carry different scopes), a permission-narrowed/revoked-in-
   scope key, or an org whose plan lacks Admin API access. The class is recorded, never the
   value — which surface the v4 key belongs to is a console-visible fact only the operator can
   read.
7. **The code defect the failure exposed:** `handleUsageReconcile` let
   `reportSource.fetch()` throw → pg-boss fails the job → the REQ-SPEC-24.1 nightly
   `assertBalances` **has not run since 10-30** (~12 days suppressed — the daily
   `balances … divergences` line last appears 10-30T03:15Z). The placeholder guard covered
   "no real key configured"; a bound-but-denied credential had no honest degrade —
   crash-or-nothing is exactly what the ticket's step-4 language forbids.

## Fix at source — the honest degrade (code, landed)

The 403 itself is an upstream credential denial — **no code change can mint permissions**;
the key act is the operator's (disposition below). The code-side defect — the lost degrade —
is fixed:

- `apps/worker/src/provider-report.ts` — **`ProviderReportFetchError`** (typed, carries
  `status`); `fetchAll` throws it on non-2xx. Same message (`provider report fetch failed:
  N`), so the recorded error text is unchanged.
- `apps/worker/src/billing-jobs.ts` — `handleUsageReconcile` catches the fetch error:
  a `ProviderReportFetchError` with status **401/403** degrades honestly — `reportError`
  recorded on `UsageReconcileResult`, a `console.error` denial line, ONE page through the
  alert sink (`kind: "report_fetch_denied"`, `reportKey: "provider-report"` — no report
  exists to key), and **`assertBalances` still runs** — the job completes instead of
  crashing. A non-denial fault (5xx, network, shape error) **rethrows** — pg-boss keeps its
  retry semantics for transients; the degrade is denial-class-only, never a catch-all.
- `packages/ledger/src/reconcile.ts` — `ReconcileAlert.kind` += `"report_fetch_denied"`
  (additive; the sink is a generic POST, `OPS_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL` is secretKeyRef-wired on the
  deployed worker — verified, the page reaches the ops-alert-catcher).
- `apps/worker/src/main.ts` — the result log prints `reportError` verbatim
  (`report=provider report fetch failed: 403`) instead of the misleading `skipped`, so the
  nightly line distinguishes unconfigured / denied / ran.

Semantics check vs the ticket: this is a **degrade-to-recorded-skip**, not a fake success —
the denial is louder than the old skip (a page nightly + `reportError` in the result + the
verbatim log line) while the balance assertion the crash was eating is restored.

## Operator act — the credential itself (exact instructions, never faked)

The bound v4 credential is denied upstream; only the operator can see/rotate it:

1. In GCP Console / `gcloud secrets versions access 4 --secret=rhema-prod-anthropic-admin-key`
   (operator shell — never in CI/records): check v4's class — is it an `sk-ant-admin…` Admin
   API key? A `sk-ant-api…` workspace key would 401, not 403; a 403 means it IS recognized
   but not authorized for this org's Admin API.
2. In the Anthropic Console **for the same organization the prod workspace keys bill to**
   (`platform.claude.com/settings/admin-keys`, org admin role): if v4 is not a current
   `sk-ant-admin…` for THIS org → **Create admin key** → seed it as
   `rhema-prod-anthropic-admin-key` version 5
   (`gcloud secrets versions add rhema-prod-anthropic-admin-key --data-file=-`, paste on
   stdin — never in command args/logs).
3. If v4 IS an `sk-ant-admin…` yet still 403s → it belongs to a different org, or this org's
   plan/surface lacks Admin API access (Admin API needs a Console-platform org on a
   Team/Enterprise-class plan; claude.ai Enterprise keys are a different surface) → mint in
   the correct org. If NO org has Admin API access → the report leg is plan-unavailable —
   record that; the degrade keeps the job green while paging nightly instead of failing it.
4. The worker resolves `versions/latest` **at each instance boot** — no deploy needed; a new
   instance binds the new version naturally, or force one:
   `gcloud run services update rhema-prod-worker-cbdaf0f --region=us-central1` (any no-op
   update mints a revision/instance).
5. Verify: the next 03:15Z firing (or an operator `send` of `usage.reconcile`) logs
   `report=…matched…` / `window=report $… vs proxy $…` instead of the denial — the
   D-ECON.1-1 / D-PRB.08-1 green-read criterion.
6. Until the degrade ships (next worker deploy) AND/OR the key is fixed, the nightly failure
   continues harmlessly — self-limiting, no retry storm, no user impact; the only suppressed
   arm is the balances assertion (restored by this PR's degrade once deployed, regardless of
   the key's state).

- Trap-check, retained-failure reading: the "7 consecutive failures" datum is retention-
  bounded (terminal rows culled at completed_on+7 d). The 10-31→11-04 gap is proven
  failed-not-absent by elimination: created jobs persist 14 d, other schedules fired those
  days, completions log — all absent → silent failures identical to the retained 7. Recorded
  honestly as 12 consecutive failures beginning **10-31** (the first firing after v4 was
  bound), of which 7 survive.
- Trap-check, "could the 403 be a code/shape bug?": no — 403 is an authorization class, not a
  request-shape class; the endpoints match the STB.4-verified contract and are unchanged
  since. The bound credential is the only variable that changed.
- Side-datum recorded, not actioned: the balances assertion's standing `6 divergences` are
  the six seeded showcase accounts (R6FOR.1's recorded fixture datum) — nightly alerting on
  them was already the pre-defect baseline; this run restores it, it does not change it.
- Honest flag: the `report_fetch_denied` page fires once nightly while the key stays denied —
